verdict.rationale: An OpenAPI 3.0.1 document covering FireHydrant's API (servers https://api.firehydrant.io/) is publicly downloadable from the official firehydrant-mcp repository. However, it is a Speakeasy build artifact for the MCP server, not a spec published from the API docs, and every standard OpenAPI path on the docs domain returned 404. missing for 10: a first-party documented spec download on the API reference/developer site, confirmation that the spec is maintained as the canonical API description, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: The official freshworks-oss/firehydrant-mcp repository publishes a FireHydrant OpenAPI document (.speakeasy/openapi.output.yaml): openapi "3.0.1"
An MCP server for interacting with FireHydrant's API.
